bv_main.name: Main Courses / Specialties
bv_main.note: Filipino favourites for the centre of the table.

bv_appetizers.name: Appetizers & Soups
bv_appetizers.note: Bright beginnings, comforting bowls and garden vegetables.

bv_desserts.name: Desserts & Drinks
bv_desserts.note: Kakanin, caramel and refreshing Filipino coolers.

items.name: Garden-Flame Chicken Inasal
items.description: Calamansi-marinated chicken grilled with annatto and lemongrass; bright, smoky and made for the middle of the table.

items.name: Claypot Garlic Adobo
items.description: Chicken simmered in soy, vinegar and bay, finished with tender garlic and a glossy savoury sauce.

items.name: Golden Kawali Platter
items.description: Crisp-skinned pork belly with a tender centre, served with a tangy dipping sauce for sharing.

items.name: Heritage Oxtail Kare-Kare
items.description: Tender oxtail and vegetables in a rich peanut sauce, with bagoong served on the side.

items.name: Slow-Simmered Beef Kaldereta
items.description: Beef, potatoes and peppers in a deep tomato sauce, gently simmered until tender.

items.name: Golden Garlic Butter Prawns
items.description: Shell-on prawns tossed in garlic butter with a lively citrus finish.

items.name: Fiesta Palabok
items.description: Rice noodles with savoury shrimp sauce, egg, crisp toppings and calamansi to squeeze over.

items.name: Garden Garlic Fried Rice
items.description: Rice wok-tossed with garlic, egg and garden vegetables; a colourful bowl for sharing.

items.name: Golden Shanghai Rolls
items.description: Crisp rolls filled with seasoned pork and vegetables, with a sweet and tangy dipping sauce.

items.name: Tamarind Garden Shrimp Sinigang
items.description: Prawns, tomatoes and greens in a clear tamarind broth with a bright, comforting sourness.

items.name: Market Garden Chopsuey
items.description: Colourful vegetables, prawns and tender meat in a light savoury sauce.

items.name: Sun-Ripened Tomato Ensalada
items.description: Juicy tomatoes, onion and fresh leaves with a light, tangy dressing.

items.name: Coastal Citrus Kinilaw
items.description: Fish dressed in vinegar and citrus with ginger, onion and a gentle chilli warmth.

items.name: Golden Caramel Leche Flan
items.description: Silky egg-and-milk custard finished with a pool of amber caramel.

items.name: Velvet Ube Halaya
items.description: Slow-cooked purple yam with a creamy finish and toasted coconut curds.

items.name: Coconut & Sweetcorn Maja
items.description: Soft coconut pudding dotted with sweetcorn and finished with toasted latik.

items.name: Garden Oven Bibingka
items.description: Warm coconut rice cake with a buttery top, cheese and salted egg.

items.name: Caramel-Crisp Banana Turon
items.description: Golden banana rolls with jackfruit, a delicate crisp wrapper and caramelised sugar.

items.name: Three-Layer Sapin-Sapin
items.description: Soft layers of coconut rice cake in classic colours, finished with fragrant latik.

items.name: Coconut Bilo-Bilo Bowl
items.description: Chewy rice dumplings, fruit and root crops gently simmered in sweet coconut milk.

items.name: Creamy Young Coconut Cooler
items.description: Chilled coconut water, tender coconut strips and a splash of milk, served over ice.

items.name: Mango Orchard Shake
items.description: Ripe mango blended with milk and ice into a smooth tropical shake.

items.name: Amber Sago & Gulaman
items.description: Sago pearls and jelly in a chilled brown-sugar cooler with a hint of vanilla.

items.name: Honey-Calamansi Garden Tea
items.description: Chilled tea lifted with calamansi and a touch of honey.
